title: Family Conflict
synopsis: Mingming's difficult relationship with his parents is typcial of the challenges faced by modern Chinese families.

fullText.simplified:
家庭战争

    有句话是这么说的：“所有的父母都在等孩子一句感谢，所有的孩子都在等父母一句道歉。”生活中，孩子常常觉得父母不理解他们，总是干涉他们的生活，限制他们的自由；父母经常因孩子的叛逆而苦恼，明明自己付出了很多，却得不到孩子的认可。
    明明是个15岁的男孩。最近他的家里“战争”不断，明明和父母之间的矛盾不断升级。终于有一天，明明受不了了，他在晚上十一点和妈妈大吵一架后，跑了出去。警察找到他的时候，他正在火车站等车，准备去外地找网友待两天。
    在派出所里，明明哭着讲出了他的烦恼。明明告诉警察，他父母对他的期望很高，希望他能考上985，所以父母把他的时间安排得很满，他要学习很多东西。这让明明压力很大，因为只要学习稍微差一点点，妈妈就会没完没了地唠叨：“一切都是为了你好”，“现在好好学，将来好好玩儿”，“在你身上花了很多钱”……这些话明明都能倒背如流了。妈妈越说，明明越烦，压力越大，现在明明连书都看不进去了。除了学习，父母还不尊重他的隐私，总是偷看他的微信聊天记录和上网记录。这样做让明明很不舒服，觉得自己好像在坐牢。他实在受不了了，本来家应该是个让人放松的地方，但是现在他非常怕回家。他一回到家就觉得压抑。
    警察把明明的话转告给了他的父母。明明妈妈哭了，她哭着说：“孩子为什么不能理解我们做父母的心情呢？我们吃过苦，走过弯路，我们不希望孩子再经历那些。让他好好学习，是想让他将来有个好工作，生活过得好一点；看他的上网记录，是因为网络上虚假的人和事太多了，孩子太小，我们怕他出问题。”
    警察把明明和父母叫到一起，指出了他们之间的问题——沟通太少。他们总是在指责对方有问题，却从来没有说过自己要的是什么，自己希望别人怎么做。这就导致他们之间的矛盾越来越多。
    在中国，有很多像明明家一样的家庭，父母和孩子都深爱着对方，却做着伤害彼此的事情。让人高兴的是，现在，中国社会越来越关注家庭和心理教育。政府、学校都有相关的心理机构帮助家长和孩子，保证亲子沟通更顺利。而且，随着文化交流的深入，传统文化与现代文化的结合，越来越多的父母开始转变家庭教育观念了。希望未来父母和孩子能真正理解对方，亲子关系更加和谐。
fullText.traditional:
家庭戰爭

    有句話是這麼說的：“所有的父母都在等孩子一句感謝，所有的孩子都在等父母一句道歉。”生活中，孩子常常覺得父母不理解他們，總是干涉他們的生活，限制他們的自由；父母經常因孩子的叛逆而苦惱，明明自己付出了很多，卻得不到孩子的認可。
    明明是個15歲的男孩。最近他的家裡“戰爭”不斷，明明和父母之間的矛盾不斷升級。終於有一天，明明受不了了，他在晚上十一點和媽媽大吵一架後，跑了出去。警察找到他的時候，他正在火車站等車，準備去外地找網友待兩天。
    在派出所裡，明明哭著講出了他的煩惱。明明告訴警察，他父母對他的期望很高，希望他能考上985，所以父母把他的時間安排得很滿，他要學習很多東西。這讓明明壓力很大，因為只要學習稍微差一點點，媽媽就會沒完沒了地嘮叨：“一切都是為了你好”，“現在好好學，將來好好玩兒”，“在你身上花了很多錢”……這些話明明都能倒背如流了。媽媽越說，明明越煩，壓力越大，現在明明連書都看不進去了。除了學習，父母還不尊重他的隱私，總是偷看他的微信聊天記錄和上網記錄。這樣做讓明明很不舒服，覺得自己好像在坐牢。他實在受不了了，本來家應該是個讓人放鬆的地方，但是現在他非常怕回家。他一回到家就覺得壓抑。
    警察把明明的話轉告給了他的父母。明明媽媽哭了，她哭著說：“孩子為什麼不能理解我們做父母的心情呢？我們吃過苦，走過彎路，我們不希望孩子再經歷那些。讓他好好學習，是想讓他將來有個好工作，生活過得好一點；看他的上網記錄，是因為網絡上虛假的人和事太多了，孩子太小，我們怕他出問題。”
    警察把明明和父母叫到一起，指出了他們之間的問題——溝通太少。他們總是在指責對方有問題，卻從來沒有說過自己要的是什麼，自己希望別人怎麼做。這就導致他們之間的矛盾越來越多。
    在中國，有很多像明明家一樣的家庭，父母和孩子都深愛著對方，卻做著傷害彼此的事情。讓人高興的是，現在，中國社會越來越關注家庭和心理教育。政府、學校都有相關的心理機構幫助家長和孩子，保證親子溝通更順利。而且，隨著文化交流的深入，傳統文化與現代文化的結合，越來越多的父母開始轉變家庭教育觀念了。希望未來父母和孩子能真正理解對方，親子關係更加和諧。

sentences.traditional: 讓人高興的是，現在，中國社會越來越關注家庭和心理教育。
sentences.pinyin: ràng rén gāo xìng de shì xiàn zài zhōng guó shè huì yuè lái yuè guān zhù jiā tíng hé xīn lǐ jiào yù
sentences.english: The parents and children love each other deeply, yet they are doing things that hurt each other.

sentences.simplified: 政府、学校都有相关的心理机构帮助家长和孩子，保证亲子沟通更顺利。
sentences.traditional: 政府、學校都有相關的心理機構幫助家長和孩子，保證親子溝通更順利。
sentences.pinyin: zhèng fǔ xué xiào dōu yǒu xiāng guān de xīn lǐ jī gòu bāng zhù jiā zhǎng hé hái zi bǎo zhèng qīn zǐ gōu tōng gèng shùn lì
sentences.english: The good news is that nowadays, Chinese society is paying more and more attention to family and mental health education.

sentences.simplified: 而且，随着文化交流的深入，传统文化与现代文化的结合，
sentences.traditional: 而且，隨著文化交流的深入，傳統文化與現代文化的結合，
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě suí zhe wén huà jiāo liú de shēn rù chuán tǒng wén huà yǔ xiàn dài wén huà de jié hé
sentences.english: Governments and schools have mental health organizations to help parents and children, ensuring smoother parent-child communication.

sentences.simplified: 越来越多的父母开始转变家庭教育观念了。
sentences.traditional: 越來越多的父母開始轉變家庭教育觀念了。
sentences.pinyin: yuè lái yuè duō de fù mǔ kāi shǐ zhuǎn biàn jiā tíng jiào yù guān niàn le
sentences.english: Moreover, with the deepening of cultural exchanges, and the integration of traditional and modern cultures, ..

sentences.simplified: 希望未来父母和孩子能真正理解对方，亲子关系更加和谐。
sentences.traditional: 希望未來父母和孩子能真正理解對方，親子關係更加和諧。

sentence_translations: Family Conflict
There is a saying that goes, “All parents are waiting for a word of thanks from their children, ..
.. and all children are waiting for a word of apology from their parents.”
In life, children often feel that their parents do not understand them, ..
.. are always interfering with their lives, and limiting their freedom.
Parents are often distressed about their children’s rebelliousness.
Clearly they have given a lot, yet they do not get recognition from their children.
Mingming is a 15-year-old boy.
Recently, there have been constant “conflicts” in his home.
The disagreements between Mingming and his parents kept escalating.
Finally, one day, Mingming couldn’t take it anymore.
After having a big argument with his mother at 11 o’clock at night, he ran out.
When the police found him, he was at the train station waiting for a train.
He was planning to go out of town to meet an online friend and stay for a couple of days.
At the police station, Mingming tearfully voiced his troubles.
Mingming told the police that his parents had high expectations for him. They hoped that he could get into a top university.
So his parents created a very busy schedule for him. He had to study many things.
This put Mingming under a lot of pressure because if his studies were even slightly below par, his mother would nag endlessly:
“This is all for your own good”, “Study hard now, so you can enjoy yourself in the future”, “We’ve spent a lot of money on you” …
These words were clearly etched in Mingming’s mind.
The more his mom talked, the more annoyed Mingming became, and the more pressure he felt.
Now, Mingming couldn’t even concentrate on studying.
Besides studying, his parents also didn’t respect his privacy.
They always secretly looked at his WeChat chat history and internet browsing history.
This made Mingming very uncomfortable, feeling as if he were in prison.
He really couldn’t take it anymore. Home should be a place for relaxation, but now he was very afraid to go home.
He felt oppressed as soon as he got home.
The police conveyed Mingming’s words to his parents.
Mingming’s mom cried and said, “Why can’t children understand the feelings of us parents?
We have experienced hardship and done things wrong. We do not want our child to go through the same.
We want him to study hard, so that in the future he can have a good job and a better life.
We checked his browsing history because there are too many fake people and things on the internet.
Our child is young, and we are afraid that something bad might happen to him.”
The police called Mingming and his parents together, pointing out the problem between them—too little communication.
They are always blaming each other for problems, but they never say what they want, or how they hope others will act.
This leads to more and more disagreements between them.
In China, there are many families like Mingming’s family.
The parents and children love each other deeply, yet they are doing things that hurt each other.
The good news is that nowadays, Chinese society is paying more and more attention to family and mental health education.
Governments and schools have mental health organizations to help parents and children, ensuring smoother parent-child communication.
Moreover, with the deepening of cultural exchanges, and the integration of traditional and modern cultures, ..
.. more and more parents are beginning to change their views on family education.
Hopefully in the future, parents and children can truly understand each other, making parent-child relationships more harmonious.
